intro: Born in the Sea of Words, she's the ancient god of the Mantra Realm and possesses the power of mantras. She built the Mantra Realm with mantras in places where she taught their language. Where there is light, there is darkness. And where there is darkness, there is evil. The Evil God sealed in the realm twisted the words within it. The truth was overturned overnight, and Kotodama, creator of the realm, became an Evil God in the eyes of the realm's people. Hitokotonushi, the true evil behind the scheme, descended upon the realm as a new god, announcing Kotodama's death sentence. Lacking the people's trust, Kotodama was deprived of her divinity. She embarked on a wandering journey of hardship in the vast world where no one was willing to light a lantern for her, and no one was willing to listen to her monologues. At the end of the Sea of Words, she gazed upon her reflection in the sea and cried out, "I speak for myself!" She had finally found the mantra that belonged to her.

intro: As the God-Empress of Light of the Three Divine Children, she has the power of light and can bring life to the world. She created love for the world, giving the emotion a name, a meaning, and a home. Those who bask in the light of Amaterasu have learned to love. They love each other, and most importantly, they love Amaterasu. In a trial in Takamagahara thousands of years ago, refusing to let her people suffer, Amaterasu created the sun, using all her divine power, and fell into a deep slumber in the center of the sun. Now, after millennia have passed, Izanami, Goddess of Destruction, has descended upon the world from the Aether Sea, and the world is standing on the brink of damnation. Amaterasu woke up from the sun and started to carry out the scheme she had been planning for thousands of years. Even when there is little hope, she has the courage to find it. God-Empress Amaterasu won't flinch before the countdown of the fateful end, because, eons ago, she promised to shelter the world with her light, even if it costs her, her life.

Some say it's hard to do business with him and he only smiles when he first greets you. But that's just his way of getting money from you. They say strange things happen if you spend the night at the hotel; the guests remember nothing and feel nothing but are magically cured of all ailments and fatigue. intro: Fujiwara no Ayako was originally a noble lady of the Fujiwara Clan, doted upon by her father. But hidden behind that loving facade was a horrifying truth. For some reason, Ayako ended up on the Cangue, where she met the dangerous convict, the Fateshaper. The pure girl became an accomplice to a great evil, leading to a prison break where none survived. The crimson flower reborn from hell-was it Ayako or the cruel Calamity God? No one know. In the end, did she fulfill her promise to her mother and reach the land where flowers bloom? intro: Born as a drifting wisp of lonely smoke, she once saw the world as an open story book that she could read and enjoy. The bonds that connect her to her friends ended her drifting days. She then found herself an alias-Enenra, and became a member of the Girls' Party. The Girls' Party often hold gatherings, attending celebrations, leaving precious memories wherever they go, until the time has come for everyone to leave. On the parting day, her friends bid her farewell before embarking on their own journey to either fulfill their wishes or achieve their goals. Years later, she returned to Heian-Kyo on a Summer Celebration. And with a loud bang, a splendid firework display appeared in the night sky. It was the firework that belonged only to the Girls' Part, marking their friendship. The fireworks are fleeting, but their friendship will last forever. And she believes that the fireworks will send her thoughts and blessings to her friends.

intro: Ryukaku is the daughter of the former leader of Yunhua City. She witnessed her mother's assassination during her childhood. Since then, she had been uprooted and wandered from place to place. Despite her tumultuous journey, she found a renowned mentor who imparted invaluable teachings to her. Through sheer determination, Ryukaku mastered the pinnacle of martial arts. And after enduring countless hardships, she ultimately defeated Yutian, the one responsible for stirring chaos in Yunhua City. In the wake of her victory, she established the Loongbreath Martial Club to empower the citizens of Yunhua City to protect themselves. After years of wandering, Yunhua City has become Ryukaku's true home, a place that lingers in her heart and fills her dreams. She has made a steadfast vow to the heavens, to Yunhua City, and to herself: no matter what the future holds, she will stand firm and safeguard the peace of Yunhua City.

intro: "Life should be measured with time." "Formulate public security regulations with clear provisions on how to protect public order in Yunhua City. intro: She's a girl who once feared raining days. After experiencing many seasonal changes in Heian-Kyo, she came to understand that all kinds of weather exist for a reason and deserve to be cherished and treated kindly. Thus, she created many dolls that can create different kinds of weather. Now, she no longer fears the dark with the companionship of her friends. New Year's Eve was a special day for Hiyoribou. On that very day, she established the Heian Vigil Sorority with a whim, leading her friends in praying for good fortune and weather for onmyoji masters. Don't worry, she has always been that little sun, emanating warmth and providing comfort. And tonight, she will continue to be a gentle night lamp, bringing sweet dreams to everyone.

intro: Delicate butterfly wings brush across the shifting cards, as the young girl dances between them. She flips the cards with her slender fingers, and the scenes transform in an instant. Evening primroses sway at the intersection of reality and fantasy, their blue petals scattering as they fell. Those who enter her game are as if plunged into the myriad of landscapes of hanafuda cards, the vibrant vistas of the twelve months flowing in like a kaleidoscope. Enjoying the many views offered while interpret the board state as if unraveling the meaning of life itself. The winner shall claim the golden leaf, while the loser must offer up their memories. When you come to your senses, you'd find steam rising from the tea cup and the cards in your hand still warm, as if the strange encounter was merely a grand dream. And the owner of the hanafuda house would sit across the table, playing her final card. She smiles faintly, looking at you. "Congratulations, this memory you staked is now mine to keep."

intro: She put an end to the never ending wars of Yamatai and founded the Castle of the Sun as the queen. A descendant of the Taira clan, yet not swayed by her family's glory or shadows. Recognized by the Chrono Jade and the people of the Castle of the Sun for her resilient and compassionate heart. She seeks to turn time toward three moments: a night where people can sleep free of war, a moment when people can savor the sweet fragrance of harvested millet, and a moment when people can stay besides the one they love. At the end of time, as the Goddess of Time, she awaits a reunion with those she holds dear.

intro: A loyal and steadfast skeletal general-fierce but never boastful, more like a towering mountain than a roaring beast. He's long grown used to the sight of death, yet his warrior's blood still burn true. In life, he was the most trusted commander under Taira no Masakado, earning the title "Iron Wall of the Taira" as he fought across countless battlefields. On the edge of death during a grueling march, he made a pact with the great spirit Higanbana: to save his soldiers, he gave up his soul, sinking into the flowerbed as part of its soil. Though the ages have dulled his power, the sea of blossoms has never broken his will. He still waits-for the day his banner rises once more.
